articleBodyHtml:
Canvas Turning and Viewer Content

The speaker mentions that turning the canvas is a necessary step, and they will read all viewer content, even if not in the current stream. They also consider implementing a dedicated stream for reading super chats, as they believe it would allow them to read more content.

Character Design and Artistic Choices

The speaker discusses character design, including the placement of a jacket in the back, the choice of a nice skirt, and the need to address the jacket issue later. They also mention that they haven't drawn a skirt in a while and want to make it a bit bigger.

Technology and Drawing Tools

The speaker mentions their desire for a tablet and acknowledges that some people are very skilled at drawing with a mouse. They express admiration for those who are highly talented with a mouse.

Farewell and Future Plans

The speaker expresses gratitude for the support and time spent together, and they plan to play a farming game called 'Pioneers of All of Town, Story of Seasons' the next day. They invite others to join them in playing the game.
